description: Original, larger contact-constrained kinematic dance interpretations. v2 names the dance revision; schema 3 retains root and contact targets. No physics, trained policy, balance or hardware-safety claim.

clips.guideText:
0.00–0.92 s: Start from exact neutral, settle into the rhythm, and nod.
0.92–15.69 s: Lift and reach each foot forward/back while turning left.
15.69–30.46 s: Return through center into a right-facing rhythm.
30.46–45.23 s: Reverse the foot reaches with visible head and weight shifts.
45.23–60.00 s: Alternate larger bounded left/right turns and lifted steps.
60.00–60.92 s: Plant both feet, soften the head motion, and return to exact neutral.

0.00–1.71 s: Start from exact neutral, settle into the rhythm, and nod.
1.71–15.43 s: Standing toprock with high alternating foot lifts and reaches.
15.43–29.14 s: Bounded left-facing turn and head accents, not a floor spin.
29.14–42.86 s: Reverse the toprock direction with deliberate head hits.
42.86–56.57 s: Right-facing lifted steps and return to neutral heading.
56.57–58.29 s: Plant both feet, soften the head motion, and return to exact neutral.

0.00–2.00 s: Start from exact neutral, settle into the rhythm, and nod.
2.00–16.00 s: Backward-and-forward lifted foot reaches in cumbia rhythm.
16.00–30.00 s: Larger left-facing turn with rocking head accents.
30.00–44.00 s: Reverse the rocking and stepping pattern to the other side.
44.00–58.00 s: Forward/back foot arcs with a right turn and recovery.
58.00–60.00 s: Plant both feet, soften the head motion, and return to exact neutral.

0.00–6.00 s: Start from exact neutral, settle into the rhythm, and nod.
6.00–18.00 s: Deliberate higher foot lifts and long forward/back reaches.
18.00–30.00 s: Turn left and shift weight while keeping the support foot planted.
30.00–42.00 s: Alternate the lifted foot with decisive head turns.
42.00–54.00 s: Turn right and return to neutral; no arms, strikes or kicks.
54.00–60.00 s: Plant both feet, soften the head motion, and return to exact neutral.

0.00–1.20 s: Start from exact neutral, settle into the rhythm, and nod.
1.20–15.60 s: Large alternating foot arcs with regular robot pulses.
15.60–30.00 s: Left-facing robot turns with head isolation.
30.00–44.40 s: Mirror the foot reaches and turn to the opposite side.
44.40–58.80 s: Right-facing turns, neck pulses, and neutral recovery.
58.80–60.00 s: Plant both feet, soften the head motion, and return to exact neutral.

0.00–1.33 s: Start from exact neutral, settle into the rhythm, and nod.
1.33–14.67 s: Larger lifted forward-back foot reaches with salsa accents.
14.67–28.00 s: Left-facing salsa steps and visible neck rhythm.
28.00–41.33 s: Reverse the basic reach with alternating lifted feet.
41.33–54.67 s: Right-facing lifted steps and return to neutral heading.
54.67–56.00 s: Plant both feet, soften the head motion, and return to exact neutral.
